$comment: Cross-folder execution order for RE's Dr.Egeria bootstrap (resource_explorer/bootstrap.py).
Each entry names a sibling directory containing a _batch.json plus one or more .md command
documents. Order is LOAD-BEARING, not cosmetic — it is why this file exists rather than the
order being encoded in directory names.
Why the order matters, learned the hard way live on 2026-08-19: a survey-definition document
processed while the Question glossary terms are absent still succeeds, but its 'Link Element
To Scope' commands silently create no ScopedBy links. The Survey Definition then looks
healthy (its own canary is present) while SurveyDefinitionReader's scoped question lookup
returns nothing for it, so every Survey-tab load silently falls back to a full instance scan.
Foundations must therefore precede questions, and questions must precede survey-definitions.
A directory present on disk but absent from this list is NOT executed — bootstrap only runs
what is named here. That is deliberate: adding a folder to the tree should not silently make
it run against Egeria. Root-level files (the CSV sources of truth, one-off probe/debug
documents) are never batches, since only directories are considered.

governance-metrics is last because nothing depends on it — a failure there cannot cascade into the batches that do have dependents. Unlike survey-definitions it IS idempotent: it creates elements and links nothing, so it has no Link Next Process Step problem.
